notes.title: BIG UPDATE: CASTLE WAR
notes.content:
Step into the Battle: Castle Wars Awaits!

Get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate strategic showdown with Castle Wars, the thrilling new card game from the creators of Holy Clash Cards. This isn’t just another card game; it’s a battle for supremacy, where your cunning, tactics, and quick decision-making will determine the fate of your castle.

In Castle Wars, you’re the master of your own fortress, but beware—danger lurks around every corner. Your enemies are relentless, waiting for the perfect moment to strike when your defenses are down. As you collect and deploy powerful cards, you’ll build and strengthen your castle, laying traps, summoning troops, and casting spells to outsmart and overpower your opponents.

But the real test begins when you’re away from the game. Will your castle withstand the siege, or will your enemies exploit your absence to launch a devastating attack? The key to victory lies in your ability to anticipate and counter every move, ensuring your castle remains unscathed.

With each battle, you’ll unlock new cards and strategies, evolving your deck and fortifying your castle against ever-growing threats. Castle Wars is more than just a game—it’s a dynamic battlefield where every decision counts, and only the strongest will survive.

Are you ready to join the competition and prove your worth as a castle commander? The war is about to begin, and the fate of your kingdom rests in your hands.

notes.title: BİG UPDATE: A major update to add a new race
notes.content:
Holy Clash Cards Gets a Heavenly Update: Rise of the Sun Belief!

Holy Clash Cards just unleashed a major update, and it's a revelation! You can now embrace a brand new belief: The Rise of the Sun. This powerful faith will bolster your deck-building prowess, allowing you to craft strategies centered around the sun's radiant power.

The best part? If your other beliefs don't resonate with you anymore, no worries! This update lets you fully commit to the Rise of the Sun, building a deck that reflects its unwavering light.

So, are you ready to become a champion of the sun? Dive into Holy Clash Cards and experience the thrill of turn-based deck-building with this exciting update! Protect your newfound belief and rise to glory!

notes.title: What will we update for you in the future?
notes.content:
What will we update for you in the future?

    New cards: We will add new cards to ensure balance in the future
    Effects: In the future, cards will behave in 3D. So, an amazing war ambiance awaits you.
    New Maps: Map selection and seasonal territory wars
    End of Season Rewards: You will now receive a certain reward as a result of Seasons battles. Additionally, end-of-season rewards will include special cards that no one can buy. This way, you will have an advantage in the next season.
